description: This file defines the class 'CognitoIdentityProvider' which provides methods to interact with AWS Cognito Identity services. It manages identity pools, credentials, and login mappings, including an invocation method that retrieves credentials via asynchronous calls.

classes.name: CognitoIdentityProvider
classes.description: A class for managing AWS Cognito Identity operations including fetching identity IDs and credentials, and updating login tokens.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with identity pool ID, client options, login tokens, and optional account ID.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Asynchronous method that retrieves the identity ID and credentials via AWS SDK calls, returning a Credentials object.

methods.name: updateLogin
methods.description: Updates the logins array with a new key-value pair.
